description: This file defines the CapabilitiesWorker class which extends Worker to perform periodic background tasks related to fetching and updating capabilities information for user accounts within an Android application. It manages worker registration, performs network-based capability refreshes, and handles exceptions associated with network requests.

classes.name: CapabilitiesWorker
classes.description: A background worker class that periodically fetches capabilities data for user accounts and updates local storage accordingly. It manages scheduling and deregistration of the worker.

methods.name: CapabilitiesWorker
methods.description: Constructor initializing the worker with application context and worker parameters.

methods.name: doWork
methods.description: Performs the main background task of fetching and updating account capabilities; handles network exceptions and determines success or failure.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Static method to register or reschedule the periodic capabilities worker with the system's WorkManager.

methods.name: deregister
methods.description: Static method to cancel any scheduled workers with the specific tag to prevent duplication.
